$comment: Shared table for CSV formula-injection sanitizing. hdfutil.SanitizeCSVValue (Go) and sanitizeCsvValue (TypeScript) both read it, so the trigger set cannot drift on one side. The control prepends a single quote to any value whose first NON-WHITESPACE character is a trigger, skipping a leading run of space, tab, CR or LF — a first-character-only test is bypassed by padding the payload with whitespace, which a spreadsheet ignores before evaluating. The quote goes at the very front, ahead of the preserved whitespace, and a value whose leading whitespace is followed by anything else is left untouched.

cases.why: leading '=' is a spreadsheet formula trigger
leading '+' is a spreadsheet formula trigger
leading '-' is a spreadsheet formula trigger
leading '@' is a spreadsheet formula trigger
leading '|' is a spreadsheet formula trigger
leading '%' is a spreadsheet formula trigger
the DDE payload this control exists to neutralise
a formula that does not start with =
a negative-looking value Excel still evaluates
Lotus-style leading @
a trigger that is not leading is not a formula
ditto for -
an empty value has no leading character
ordinary text is untouched
already neutralised; the quote is not a trigger, so it is not doubled
only one quote is prepended regardless of trigger count
OWASP: spreadsheets trim leading whitespace before evaluating, so a leading space does NOT save the trigger — the value must be neutralised
a leading TAB is trimmed by the spreadsheet before formula evaluation, same bypass as a space
a leading carriage return is trimmed likewise
a leading line feed is trimmed likewise
mixed leading whitespace run before a non-'=' trigger is still neutralised
leading whitespace with NO trigger after it must NOT be quoted — the guard only fires on a real trigger
an all-whitespace value has no trigger and is left untouched
leading space then a non-ASCII rune: the first non-whitespace char is the multi-byte rune, not a trigger, so it is not neutralised
a formatted number is untouched
a NEGATIVE number does trigger, which is why numeric columns must not be sanitised
non-ASCII first character: Go compares the first BYTE, which is never a trigger for multi-byte UTF-8
astral first character, same reason
CJK first character, same reason
